finding.claim: Sync verifier accepts unsigned tokens when key is null or '' and the algorithm allow-list is non-empty (PLAUSIBLE, config-dependent). Empty-key guard and missing-signature check are both skipped.
finding.source: Attacker-supplied token with empty signature segment, e.g. base64url({"alg":"RS256"}).base64url({"sub":"admin"}).
finding.sink: validateAlgorithmAndSignature signature check skipped at verifier.js:169 (if (signature && ...)); claims accepted and returned from verify at verifier.js:426.

trace.note: keyType computed; null is typeof 'object', '' is typeof 'string'
type check permits null and empty string
if (key && ...) is false, so detectPublicKeyAlgorithms/prepareKeyOrSecret never run and the empty-key guard at line 38-40 is bypassed
missingSignature check needs hasKey true, so it does not fire
missingKey check needs a non-empty signature, so it does not fire
header.alg must be in allowedAlgorithms; operator-configured non-empty list passes
signature empty, so verifySignature is skipped

finding.guards_checked: Key type check (verifier.js:507) permits null/''; empty-secret guard (verifier.js:38-40) unreachable when key falsy; missingSignature/missingKey checks (verifier.js:274-278) require a signature; allow-list (verifier.js:162) passes for configured algorithms. No guard rejects an empty signature when the key is falsy.

finding.claim: Cache ignores exp for tokens without a numeric iat, so an expired token is accepted from cache for up to cacheTTL after expiry (PLAUSIBLE, requires cache enabled and issuer omitting iat).
finding.source: Holder of a validly signed token that has numeric exp but no numeric iat (e.g. signer noTimestamp:true with expiresIn), presenting it again after exp.
finding.sink: Cache hit returns the cached payload without expiry re-check at verifier.js:377.

trace.note: cache enabled only when cache option is truthy/positive (default disabled)
exp-based cacheValue[2] is only computed inside if (hasIat)
without iat, cacheValue[2] stays 0 and is set to maxTTL, ignoring exp
hit condition: min===0 and max not reached (now <= max) returns cached payload
cached payload returned with no exp validation

finding.guards_checked: exp validator (verifier.js:306-323) runs only on cache miss; maxTTL cap (verifier.js:134) bounds but does not enforce exp; signer sets iat by default (signer.js:96) so the gap needs noTimestamp or an issuer that omits iat.
